# threndle.ai

> Independent AI implementation consultancy for small businesses in the Fraser Valley,
> British Columbia, Canada. We connect Claude (the AI assistant made by Anthropic) to the
> tools a business already uses — accounting, CRM, payments, email, files, and team ops —
> and put the biggest operational bottleneck on autopilot.

We do not replace software or ask clients to switch platforms. We build small, reliable
workflows inside the existing stack. Every engagement starts with a diagnostic rather than a
packaged offer: we ask what is actually consuming the week across money, sales, marketing,
customer service, admin, and hiring, then scope against the answer.

Contact: hello@threndle.ai · Fraser Valley, BC, Canada · https://www.linkedin.com/company/threndle-ai/

## Services

- Claude AI automation for bookkeeping and cash flow — reconcile Stripe payouts to QuickBooks,
  chase overdue invoices, flag mismatched transactions.
- CRM automation that keeps leads warm — update records in HubSpot, Pipedrive, or Zoho Bigin,
  draft follow-ups, flag leads that have gone quiet.
- AI workflow automation for admin and reporting — summarize meetings, build weekly reports,
  keep Slack or Monday.com current without manual copy and paste.
- Implementation without replacing existing tools — Claude works inside QuickBooks, HubSpot,
  Slack, Google Workspace, Stripe, and dozens more.

## Pricing

- Foundation — fixed-price scope for one bottleneck, typically CA$3,000 to CA$3,500.
- Multi-workflow builds — CA$6,000 to CA$9,000.
- Partner retainer — CA$750 to CA$1,500 per month, ongoing.

Final pricing is set after the diagnostic and a scoping call. Figures above are ranges, not quotes.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://threndle.ai/): full service overview, plain-English explainers, and both FAQ sections.
- [Diagnostic](https://threndle.ai/diagnostic): a short questionnaire that returns a recommendation
  on which bottleneck to fix first. Interactive form, not reference content.
